bio.text: Franklin D. Cooke has represented the 16th District in the Delaware House of Representatives since 2018.
Cooke was born and raised in Dunlieth and is a retired New Castle County police officer and former executive assistant to County Executive Thomas P. Gordon.
Cooke chaired the Law Enforcement Accountability Task Force of the 151st General Assembly and graduated from DeLaWarr High School and Cheyney State University.
